name: r8-s-pf256-disp
author: solx-loop
description: What the small-input fixed cost is made of. Measured on the rented B200 with harness CUPTI timing, cold L2 after the zero flush: (1) The CUPTI span of an empty kernel is 1.45-1.65 us at any grid size (1 to 1536 CTAs). (2) The first DRAM access costs about 0.6 us over that; each further dependent load costs about 0.45 us, with no extra cost for new 4 KB, 2 MB or 8 MB pages, so TLB misses do not matter. (3) Reading 6.3 MB (Q+K at 128 tokens, no stores) costs 2.4 us over an empty kernel, about 2.6
